num.description: Number of commits to get. If set to -1, will return all available commits, ( will be slow).

authorName.description: Single author name to filter by. Takes priority over authorNames if set. Accepts patterns.

authorNames.description: Author name(s) to filter by. Supports single or multiple authors. Accepts patterns.

since.description: Show commits more recent than a specific date

until.description: Show commits older than a specific date (for date range filtering with since)
